QuestInfo.name: The Man with Perfect Memory
QuestInfo.0: NOW you can ask 10 Boogies about Chromile.
QuestInfo.1: 10 Boogies told you to talk to an archaeologist, but she warns you that he has a bit of a temper. Go find him at #b#eRugged Rocky Zone#n#k.
QuestInfo.2: 10 Boogies mentioned an archaeologist who's done extensive research of the area. He's a bit cranky, but keep trying!
QuestInfo.parent: Where in Maple World is Chromile the Knight?

0.0: So, what do you need? Ask me anything! \r\n#L0##bTell me what you know about Chromile. He was last seen in Perion and I'm trying to find him.#l\n#k
0.1: Oh, yeah! I sent that info over a while back. A lot of stories seem to point to Perion as his birthplace, but I couldn't confirm it. I met a scholar over at Boulder Mountain that said he knew Chromile; even said he'd seen him around Perion recently! I tried to get some more info out of him, but that old coot had a temper like a Horny Mushroom! \r\n#L0##bWho did you talk to?#l\n#k
0.2: There's a really mean old archaeologist named Winston that hangs around here. He claims to have the best memory in Maple World, but he's also got at least the second best temper I've ever seen. You might wanna go talk to him about it...\r\n#L0##bWhere can I find this archaeologist?#l\n#k

no.0: Good choice, he's a real creep.

0.3: Winston is at #b#m102020400##k. I can move you there, if you want.

1.0: Who are you? Why are you stepping there? Get out of here! \r\n#L0##bOh, sorry. Are you Winston? You're just like old man Limbert... #l\n#k
1.1: You show up at MY camp unannounced and compare me to a man I don't know?! I've killed men for less! Go away!

npc.0: I usually see Winston yelling at passersby from a rock perch in the #b#eRugged Rocky Zone#k#n, up in the North Rocky Mountain. Follow the road north... you won't miss him. Nobody is that lucky.
